stem: A recurring quality issue appears after harvest, but genealogy links crop rooms, source plants, irrigation batches, and dry-room lots for only half the affected product. What is the strongest systems priority?
choices: Restore consistent end-to-end identifiers and event linkage so future investigations can define affected scope and compare process history
Collect more final product photographs only
rationale: End-to-end genealogy is foundational for affected-scope analysis and process comparison when outcomes emerge late in the production chain.
